info.name: MLS Grid RESO Web Lookup Property API

params.name: $filter
params.description:
OData `$filter` expression. Required pattern uses `OriginatingSystemName eq '<system>'` combined with
`ModificationTimestamp gt <UTC datetime>` for incremental replication. Replication queries are
restricted to a limited set of searchable fields documented per resource.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Reduces payload size.

params.name: $expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to expand inline. Common values for Property are `Media`, `Rooms`, and `UnitTypes`.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

items.docs: Replicate Property listings filtered by `OriginatingSystemName` and `ModificationTimestamp`. Use `$expand=Media,Rooms,UnitTypes` to include nested resources and `@odata.nextLink` for pagination.

params.name: $expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to expand inline. Common values for Property are `Media`, `Rooms`, and `UnitTypes`.

items.docs: Retrieve a single Property record by its prefixed `ListingKey` (e.g. `actris-1234567`).
